source.how: The same read of Map 5 as ASC 1 and 1A (FOLLOWUPS 130): the Areas_of_Special_Concern frame's /VP viewport gave the page-to-ground affine (residual 0.89 ft) and the pink-filled (RGB 1, 0.745, 0.745) outlines were read out of the page as vector paths. The map's numerals are in a font the page does not decode, so ASC 3 is named by what it holds: of the nineteen outlines it is the only one whose lots are all R-5, the district the text says the plan gives 'both Dogwood Park and Wildwood' (#L1208-L1209), and it takes in the established 1950s grid of NW Lakeview Drive, NW Greenwood Drive and NW 134th to 140th Avenues north of NW Laidlaw Road; one undecoded glyph sits at its centre. 89.8 acres. Checked by laying the county's current taxlots over it: 140 lots are at least 90 percent inside (R-5 140); the 4 lots it cuts, 1N121AB03800 (R-5, 78 percent inside), 1N121AB08200 (R-5, 50 percent inside), 1N121BC09100 (R-6, 35 percent inside), 1N121BC10200 (R-6, 27 percent inside), are added whole, because inside the urban growth boundary the review only carries CLEAR-OBJECTIVE and a cut lot left unanswered would hide the question. A lot 10 percent or less inside is outside.
